title: Chopping Block
html:
Chopping Block is an arcade map in OpenFront. As of Update 34.0 it is no longer part of the public game rotation, but it can still be picked for custom lobbies and single player.

Nations

The map features 32 named nations, including Boxey, Gridsly, Blocko, Squarm, Boximilian and Rectanglo.

Details

  • Categories: Arcade
  • Nations: 32
  • Public rotation frequency: removed from public rotation in Update 34.0 (was 5)
